data: Apple's net sales were $383.3 billion in fiscal 2023 (the year ended September 30, 2023). For fiscal 2025 (the year ended September 27, 2025), I recall total net sales of about $416.2 billion, which would be an increase of roughly $32.9 billion, or about 8.6 percent over the two years. That works out to a compound annual growth rate of around 4.2 percent. Fiscal 2025 is the figure I'm less sure of, since I'm working from memory and haven't checked it against Apple's 10-K, so please confirm it in the filing before relying on it.
